name: Winback / Re-engagement - ShopStyle US
description: Graduated 3-touch re-engagement series (90-day / 180-day / sunset-warning) with a re-engagement check before each escalation, ending in automated sunset for subscribers who remain inactive through the full series.

exitCriteria.query: SELECT SubscriberKey FROM ShopStyle_Subscribers WHERE SubscriberStatus IN ('Unsubscribed', 'Sunset') OR EmailOptIn = 0

branches.name: ReEngaged
branches.criteria: EXISTS(_Open WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-1-WEMISSYOU.SendDate) OR EXISTS(_Click WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-1-WEMISSYOU.SendDate)

configurationArguments.subjectLine: It's been a while — 25% off to come back

branches.name: ReEngaged
branches.criteria: EXISTS(_Open WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-2-INCENTIVE.SendDate) OR EXISTS(_Click WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-2-INCENTIVE.SendDate)

branches.name: ReEngaged
branches.criteria: EXISTS(_Open WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-3-SUNSET-WARNING.SendDate) OR EXISTS(_Click WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey AND EventDate >= Activity.EMAIL-3-SUNSET-WARNING.SendDate)

activities.name: Flag Series Complete for Sunset Enforcement

configurationArguments.updateStatement: UPDATE Winback_Journey_Log SET InactivityTier = 'Sunset' WHERE SubscriberKey = Contact.SubscriberKey
configurationArguments.notes: Marks the subscriber eligible for automation-studio/sql/17-sunset-inactive-subscribers.sql, which runs weekly after this journey's Monday cohort reaches this point.
